title: RideVela — Analytics
description: The owner's core list: app overview, live operations, users & drivers, revenue & payments, system health, alerts.

list.name: currency
list.label: Currency
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM payments UNION SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM trips ORDER BY 1

options.content: **How to use this page** — pick the period at the top right (default: *today*). Every number has an **ⓘ** that says exactly what it counts. **Green** = healthy, **orange** = keep an eye on it, **red** = act now. Money is in the **Currency** chosen at the top left; "today" follows the **Business time zone**. Click a row title (📊 🚕 👥 💰 🖥️ 🚨) to fold a section away. Anything in **🚨 Alerts → Firing now** needs someone.

panels.title: Total users
panels.description: Riders and drivers with an account (deleted accounts excluded).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND role <> 'admin'

panels.title: DAU
panels.description: People who used the app today (${tz} day). One row per person per day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM user_active_days WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date

panels.title: MAU
panels.description: Distinct people who used the app in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_active_days WHERE day > (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date - 30

panels.title: DAU / MAU
panels.description: Stickiness: how much of the monthly base comes back daily.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM user_active_days WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date)::float / NULLIF((SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_active_days WHERE day > (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date - 30), 0)

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Sign-ups in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role <> 'admin' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Total rides (all time)
panels.description: Every ride ever requested.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status <> 'scheduled'

panels.title: Completed rides
panels.description: Rides completed in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)

panels.title: Cancelled rides
panels.description: Rides requested in the range that were cancelled (by rider or driver).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: No driver found
panels.description: Demand we could not serve — every one is a lost ride.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status IN ('no_drivers','expired') AND $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: Completion rate
panels.description: Of rides requested in the range that have ended, the share that completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed','cancelled','no_drivers','expired')), 0) FROM trips WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: Revenue (${currency})
panels.description: Gross: fares and cancellation fees collected in the range, before refunds.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(p.amount), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))

panels.title: Average fare (${currency})
panels.description: Average final fare of completed rides in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(fare_final) FROM trips WHERE status = 'completed' AND currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)

panels.title: Rides by outcome
panels.description: Every ride requested, by where it ended up.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(requested_at, $__interval, 0), status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM trips WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) AND status <> 'scheduled' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue (${currency})
panels.description: Gross collected and the platform's share, per interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(paid_at, $__interval, 0), sum(amount) AS "Gross", sum(platform_fee) AS "Platform commission" FROM (SELECT COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at) AS paid_at, p.amount, p.platform_fee FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}') s WHERE $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active rides
panels.description: Requested through in progress, right now.

panels.title: Available
panels.description: Online and free to take a ride.

panels.title: Unassigned rides
panels.description: Riders waiting for a driver right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status IN ('requested','matching')

panels.title: Avg pickup time
panels.description: Actual time from a driver accepting to arriving at the pickup, in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(extract(epoch FROM arrived_at - accepted_at)) FROM trips WHERE arrived_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at)

panels.title: Driver acceptance rate
panels.description: Share of ride offers drivers accepted (vs declined or let expire). No data = no offers in range.

panels.title: Driver cancellation rate
panels.description: Of rides a driver accepted, the share that driver then cancelled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND cancelled_by = 'driver')::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE accepted_at IS NOT NULL), 0) FROM trips WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: Match time p95
panels.description: Request to driver accepted, 95th percentile, over the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE requested_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE (requested_at AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date

panels.title: Riders waiting > 2 min
panels.description: Searches running longer than a normal match window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE status IN ('requested','matching') AND requested_at < now() - interval '2 minutes'

panels.title: Ride offers to drivers (per minute)
panels.description: Accepted / declined / expired offers.

panels.title: User & driver growth (30 days)
panels.description: Accounts at the end of each day. Driver dates before 2026-09-23 are when tracking began, not onboarding.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d AS time, (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.role <> 'admin' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.created_at < d + interval '1 day') AS "Users", (SELECT count(*) FROM driver_profiles dp WHERE dp.created_at < d + interval '1 day') AS "Drivers" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz), interval '1 day') d ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active users per day (30 days)
panels.description: Daily active people, split into riders and drivers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.day::timestamptz AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dp.user_id IS NULL) AS "Riders", count(*) FILTER (WHERE dp.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS "Drivers" FROM user_active_days a LEFT JOIN driver_profiles dp ON dp.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.day >= $__timeFrom()::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role <> 'admin' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
SELECT count(*) FROM driver_profiles WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date
SELECT count(*) FROM user_active_days a JOIN driver_profiles dp ON dp.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.day = (now() AT TIME ZONE '${tz}')::date

panels.title: Driver utilisation
panels.description: Share of online driver-time spent on a trip, over the range.

panels.title: Rides per driver
panels.description: Completed rides per driver who completed any, in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::float / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT driver_id), 0) FROM trips WHERE status = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
SELECT count(*) FROM driver_profiles

panels.title: Top drivers (range)
panels.description: Most completed rides in the range; earned = driver share incl. tips.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, 'Driver ' || right(u.phone, 4)) AS "Driver", count(*) AS "Rides", round(sum(COALESCE(p.driver_payout, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Earned" FROM trips t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.driver_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.status = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(t.completed_at) GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(sum(p.amount), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))

SELECT COALESCE(sum(p.platform_fee), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))

panels.title: Net revenue
panels.description: Commission minus the part of refunds the platform bears (refunds minus the driver-share clawback).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.platform_fee) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.amount) FROM payment_refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.id = r.payment_id WHERE r.status = 'succeeded' AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT -sum(amount) FROM ledger_entries WHERE type = 'adjustment' AND note LIKE 'Refund clawback%' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)), 0)

panels.title: Driver earnings
panels.description: What drivers earned: their share of fares, tips and cancellation compensation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(p.driver_payout), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))

panels.title: Paid out to drivers
panels.description: Withdrawals to drivers' bank accounts in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(-sum(amount), 0) FROM ledger_entries WHERE type = 'withdrawal' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(sum(r.amount), 0) FROM payment_refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.id = r.payment_id WHERE r.status = 'succeeded' AND p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at)

panels.title: Payment success rate
panels.description: Settled vs failed payments started in the range (all currencies).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded'))::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded','failed')), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.created_at)
SELECT count(*) FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Cash share
panels.description: Share of settled payments paid in cash.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash')::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM payments WHERE status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(sum(p.tip), 0) FROM payments p JOIN trips t ON t.id = p.trip_id WHERE p.currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(COALESCE(t.completed_at, p.updated_at))
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE kind = 'cancellation' AND status IN ('captured','collected','partial','refunded') AND currency = '${currency}' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)

panels.title: Payment failures (Prometheus)
panels.description: Capture/charge attempts that failed, incl. retries, since the range began.

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind AS "Kind", method AS "Method", status AS "Status", currency AS "Currency", count(*) AS "Payments", round(sum(amount)::numeric, 2) AS "Amount" FROM payments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: WebSocket connections
panels.description: Apps connected for live updates right now (riders + drivers).
